entities.title: The rules, one by one
entities.summary: One test per rule in RULES §1–§14 and §17, at its boundaries, including the probabilities over seeded runs.
criteria: Starting values, clamping and costs that never go below 0
The mood roll, disaffection at or below the threshold, the accounts in debt, in credit and at exactly 0
Plots: months 1 and 2, the pause, the ally's order and who never counts
Reports, requests, affordability, granting and refusing
Decisions, the Swiss account and loans, in RULES' order of checks
Assassination, war, news and revolution, with their odds
The rating, and the data tables' sizes and order

checks.symbol: a reign starts with RULES §1 and §2's values
changes clamp each group to 0-9
monthly costs never fall below 0
the mood: threshold 2-4 then revolution strength 10-12, each equally likely
disaffected means popularity at or below the threshold
accounts: in debt, nothing is paid and four values drop by 1
accounts: the bankrupt penalties stop at 0
accounts: in credit the costs are paid, even into debt; exactly 0 does nothing
plots: nothing happens in months 1 and 2, statuses are kept
plots: cleared and suppressed while the month is below the pause
plots: a disaffected faction rises with the first strong enough disaffected group, else hires an assassin
plots: the faction itself and loyal groups never count as allies
reports: available only with money, loyal police and strong police (strictly above)
requests: the first unused from a random start, wrapping, and marked used at once
requests: only 22 places are looked at; if none is unused, all marks reset and it draws again
affordability follows RULES §8.3 exactly
granting applies the changes, then the money; costs never below 0
refusing costs the requester exactly what it would have gained, and nothing else
the five sections hold D1-D6, D7-D9, D10-D13, D14-D16 and D17-D19 in order
a decision is used once taken, except the bodyguard and the Swiss account
the bodyguard adds 2 to the President's strength with no upper limit
the helicopter decision gives the helicopter
the Swiss account takes half the treasury rounded down, if that is at least 1
loans: too early below month 3 + pick(5); always drawn first
loans: refused when the power is disaffected; granted is popularity × 30 + pick(200), once
loans: the checks run too early, no more, refused, granted
assassination: one pick(3) for the faction; only a plotting assassin strikes
assassination: all three plotting kills without a draw; strong or loyal police foil it
assassination: unloved and weak police leave it to a coin flip (0 kills)
war: the Neighbour is hostile when unloved (≤) and strong (≥ the threshold)
war: one chance in three of invasion
war: a threat rallies the Army, Peasants, Landowners and police
war: the forces count loyal home groups plus the President, against every disaffected group
war: the Neighbour wins if its force plus the swing reaches ours
the swing is -1, 0 or +1 and the helicopter starts two times in three
news: one chance in three, then the first unused headline from pick(6)
news: with all six used there is no news, but pick(6) is still drawn
news: a headline is marked used and moves no money
revolution: up to three picks, stopping at the first faction that plans one
revolution: helpers are groups 1-6 above the threshold; rebels add the ally's strength
on foot: caught when floor(u × (guerrillas ÷ 3 + 0.4)) is not 0
the revolt is crushed when the rebels are at most the President, the helper and the swing
punishment zeroes the rebel faction and its ally; victory sets the helper to 9 and pauses plots
the rating: popularity + 3 a month, and if alive 10 + floor(Swiss ÷ 10)
the data tables have RULES §17's sizes and order

entities.title: The reign's flow
entities.summary: Screens come in RULES §4's order, every ending is reached as RULES says, and the report offer is the month's last step.
criteria: The reign opens with welcome, the treasury and a free first report
A calm month, a bankrupt month, the audience and the decision follow RULES §4
Every ending: assassinated, executed, flown out, caught, escaped on foot, overthrown
Exactly one report offer per completed month, none in a reign's last month
The rating and the best
The same seed and keys replay the same reign

checks.symbol: the reign opens with welcome, the treasury and a free first report, then month 1
a calm month follows RULES §4: audience, decision, news, then the month's only report offer
a bankrupt month: penalties first, then the notice and a plot check; the offer waits for the month's end
the treasury at exactly 0 neither pays nor is penalised
a bought report costs 1 and shows the month
granting a request applies it; refusing costs the requester its gain
an unaffordable request: the dialog by itself, cash short, must refuse, then refused
advice is offered after the audience and shown on yes, changing nothing
taking a decision: section, advice offer, dialog, treasury; the report offer ends the month
declining a decision's dialog goes back to the menu
the Swiss account: its own screen, and the decision is over; repeatable
the bodyguard decision adds 2 and stays available
a loan: wait, result, treasury, and the decision is over; too early in month 1
a granted loan draws pick(5) then pick(200) and hides the option
a used-up section shows the note and returns to the menu
an unaffordable decision: dialog by itself, cash short, back to the menu
ending: killed when all three factions hire assassins
an assassin can miss, and the war check still follows
ending: executed after a lost war without a helicopter
ending: a lost war with a helicopter: away (2 in 3) or executed under the failed helicopter
a won war wipes out the Neighbour's strength and the month goes on to the decision
a threat of war rallies the home groups, then the decision
ending: escape on foot, caught or across the border
ending: escape by helicopter after a revolt, or a dead engine and the mountains
ending: overthrown when the rebels are too strong
a crushed revolt: punish, the helper to 9, plots paused, a plot check, then the month's only report offer
exactly one report offer per completed month, its last step, after the revolution check; offers draw nothing
no report offer after a game-ending screen: the reign's last month has none
the help list ignores other keys and shows itself again; an unlisted group is a joke and a run
alone: no one to ask, any key, and the fight goes on without a helper
the rating counts popularity, months, and for the living 10 and the Swiss money
the best so far includes this reign; a new best is flagged only when beaten
the same seed and keys replay the same reign

entities.title: The generator and the order of draws
entities.summary: The generator matches RULES §15.4, and a month draws in exactly RULES' order, nothing else drawing.
criteria: The generator follows RULES §15.4 exactly
pick(n) is floor(u × n)
A quiet month draws in RULES §15.4's order
Advice, dialogs, reports, the Swiss account and plots draw nothing
snapshot has exactly the parity shape

checks.symbol: the generator follows RULES §15.4 exactly, and its state is the seed plus a constant per draw
pick(n) is floor(u × n), uniform over 0…n−1
nothing draws but the rules: advice, dialogs, reports, the Swiss account and plots do not
snapshot has exactly the parity shape, in RULES' terms
a quiet month draws exactly in RULES §15.4 order

checks.description: The verify role's parity run: at least 10,000 reigns per key policy against the baseline, the full state compared after every screen (docs/TEST-PLAN.md row 6). It runs outside this repository.

entities.title: Input quirks
entities.summary: Only Y means yes; digits count only in range; keys a screen doesn't expect mean no or next.
criteria: Only Y and y mean yes
Only single digits 1…max count
Any key but 1–5 at the menu is no decision; an unlisted or used number goes back
The screens the original timed ignore their key
An unavailable report offer only waits: Y does not buy
M is like any other key to the engine

checks.symbol: only Y and y mean yes
digits: only single keys 1…max count
Y in either case buys a report; any other key skips it
any key but Y refuses the request; Y grants it
at the menu, any key but 1-5 means no decision this month
in a section, an unlisted or used number goes back to the menu without an error
the screens the original timed ignore the key they return
an unavailable report offer only waits for any key: Y does not buy
the engine treats an M like any other key: the platform keeps it from reaching the game

entities.title: Every reign ends
entities.summary: Bots with six key policies play 6,000 reigns, checking the state's bounds at every screen.
criteria: Every reign ends with the final report, without an error
Groups stay 0–9; costs, the bodyguard and the Swiss account never go negative; the Swiss account and the month never fall
Every engine screen kind is shown at least once

checks.symbol: bots play 6,000 full reigns without errors, and every reign ends with the final report
